discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed on the current head: `toProviderConnectionResponse()` removes the nested AWS `sessionToken` from create, list, detail, and update responses while keeping it server-side for signing. The Bedrock API regression checks all four responses.

Fixed on the current head. Provider API routes now use `toProviderConnectionResponse()` for create, list, detail, and update, and that helper strips `providerSpecificData.sessionToken` for AWS credential-form providers. The stored token remains available server-side; the API regression asserts it is absent from every response.

Valid catch, fixed in a4e8066. A search scoped away from public web access must not be rerouted through an external provider, that would break the scope the client asked for. prepareWebSearchFallbackBody now returns the body untouched with the fallback disabled whenever any built-in web_search tool carries external_web_access:false, so the whole request goes to the upstream as if this feature did not exist. Covered by a new unit test.

True, and worse than it looks: if the client registered its own tool under this reserved name, the interceptor would execute the client's tool as if it were a search. Fixed in a4e8066. The conversion now checks the outgoing tool names first and skips the whole rewrite (body returned unchanged) when the name is already taken. Test added.
